title: Digital Footprints and How AI Works
subject: digital

sections.body: Your DIGITAL FOOTPRINT is the trail you leave online: posts, photos, comments, searches. It can last a very long time, even if you delete something.
Before posting, ask: Would I be OK with my teacher, family or a future employer seeing this?
AI chatbots learn patterns from huge amounts of text, then predict likely next words. They don't 'know' things like people do.
That's why AI can sound confident but still be WRONG. This is sometimes called 'hallucinating'. Always check important facts.

quiz.q: Why should you think before posting a photo online?
options: It might stay online for a very long time
hints: Can you always delete things completely?
Others can save or screenshot posts.
Writing in permanent marker is hard to rub out. Posting online can be like that.
quiz.explain: Online posts can last a long time and be copied, even if you delete them.

quiz.q: Why can an AI chatbot give a wrong answer?
options: It predicts likely words and can make mistakes
hints: How does an AI chatbot make its answers?
It works with patterns, not true understanding.
Autocomplete on a phone guesses your next word and is sometimes wrong. AI chatbots are a much bigger version of this idea.
quiz.explain: AI predicts likely words from patterns, so it can sound sure and still be wrong.
